meaning:
§ Peor = "cleft"
a mountain peak in Moab belonging to the Abarim range and near Pisgah

elsewhere.note: Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, that looks down on the desert.
Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we have not cleansed ourselves to this day, although there came a plague on the congregation of Yahweh,
